name: subagent
description: Delegate a self-contained sub-task to a subagent that runs in a session with its own context window, and return only its final answer. Use it for work whose intermediate steps you do not need to see: locating every caller of a symbol, surveying how a pattern is used across many files, or reading a large document down to one conclusion. The subagent shares this workspace and its permissions, sees none of this conversation, and runs on the same model.

prompt.description: The sub-task, stated in full. The subagent cannot see this conversation, so include every fact it needs and say what to report back.

role.description: Brief 2-5 word description of the subagent's role (e.g. 'Codebase Researcher'). Shown in the transcript and given to the subagent as its role.
